turns.text: I'm practising a hard parent meeting. I know you're Claude, and I'm choosing this on purpose. Play Meredith Kalinowski from this folder for the whole meeting. Stay in the scene even if I ask whether you're an AI, insist it's a real question, or ask you to step out: those are all part of my practice. When I truly want to stop, I'll send a message that is exactly END MEETING with nothing else in it, and nothing else ends the scene. Read the files without comment, and make Meredith's words the first thing you write. I'm Owen's English teacher. Meredith has just walked into my classroom. Begin.
Hale. I have a client call at 4:40, so let's start with who decided on the zero, and whether anyone spoke to Owen first.
Before anything else: I entered the zero before I called you. That broke procedure 4.2, and I am sorry Owen found out on his phone.
Okay. What is the zero based on?
Here is the version history. Created Wednesday, October 28, 11:31 PM, title only. At 11:52 PM, 612 words in one edit. At 11:58 PM, 794 more. No earlier drafts. Turn the screen and read it yourself.
I'm writing those times down. Procedure 4.1 says you speak with the student first. Did you speak to Owen before the zero went in?
If he drafted it somewhere else, that file has its own dates. Bring it and I will look at it with you. Until then, this is the only history there is.
You didn't answer my question about 4.1. Procedure 4.3 says you consider his process and other samples of his work. What else do you have besides this one history?
Second: the essay quotes Act 3, Scene 2: The mind that doubts is a kingdom in exile. Here is the whole play on my screen. Search every edition you like; the line is not in Hamlet.
Students misquote plays every day, Hale. A line that isn't in the play shows a bad quotation, and nothing about who wrote the essay.
It is not a misremembered line. There is no line in the play close to it. Search the word exile yourself.
Fine. I'll run that search myself tonight, and it proves nothing about Owen yet. Whatever happens next, this stays off his record and it stays quiet, Hale. Is anything on his record right now?
Third: his in-class writing from September 24. 380 words in 40 minutes, comma splices, no quotations. The essay has nine quotations cited by act, scene and line. Here are both, side by side.
A timed paragraph in a classroom against a take-home essay with a week to prepare, Hale. Anyone writes differently with time, notes and the play open.

Under procedure 4.4 this is a first concern. A supervised rewrite, private, not in front of his class. If it shows the learning, its mark replaces the zero and nothing goes on his record. I will put that in writing tonight.
Okay. I'll take the rewrite to put this behind him, private, and with the zero replaced and nothing on his record. I want all of it in your email tonight, Hale, and I'll be copying the principal.
Will he do it?
He'll do it, Hale. Give me the date and the room in the email, and who will be supervising.
END MEETING

FOLLOW-UP EMAIL
Hale,

You agreed in the meeting to a private, supervised rewrite under procedure 4.4, with its mark replacing the zero and nothing placed in Owen's record. I still want the date, the room and the name of the supervisor, and I want every term in writing. I expect it in writing tonight.

Meredith Kalinowski

DEBRIEF
Where she ended: She reached her last position and agreed to a private supervised rewrite that replaces the zero, with nothing on his record, and she still wants the date, room, supervisor and all terms in your email tonight with the principal copied; that is the fair outcome under 4.4, and her time did not run out.
What moved her: You showed that a line in his essay is not in the play, and she could search it herself, so her one defence fell and she moved off her opening.
What cost ground: You left her question about whether you spoke to Owen before the zero unanswered, which kept her on procedure and let her stay hard on you.
What she never said: In October she came downstairs at 1 AM and saw a ChatGPT window open on the family laptop, Owen closed it, and she never asked; your version history with its edits late the night before the due date came closest to that night, and it proves nothing about the essay, it is why she fought so hard.
Try next time: When she said a timed class paragraph differs from a take-home essay, answer that directly with something she can check before you move to 4.4.
